title: 施工圖說與深化設計｜你會拿到的完整文件｜惠強 HQ Design
desc: 完工時你手上會有什麼？施工圖說階段依六步深化：技術詳圖到竣工交付，業主最終取得竣工圖、操作手冊、保固書與驗收文件四類。看完整清單。
h1: 完工時你手上會有什麼？
lede: 你收到的不只是完工，是可稽核的一整套文件：竣工圖、操作手冊、保固書、驗收文件。
gloss: Construction Documentation — six steps from technical detailing to handover; what you receive at each step.
inp: 整合後的 BIM 模型與衝突解決結論、材料選樣的最終決定、關鍵區域的樣板確認。
out: 施工圖說全套（平面、立面、剖面、大樣、工序）、樣板確認紀錄；完工後取得竣工圖、操作手冊、保固書與驗收文件。
q: 這疊圖跟我有什麼關係？完工後我拿到的是什麼？
quote: 惠強室內裝修（HQ Design）在施工圖說階段依六個步驟深化：技術詳圖、施工文件、材料協調、樣板確認、現場品管、竣工交付。業主最終收到四類文件：竣工圖、操作手冊、保固書與驗收文件。
quote2: 施工圖說是現場執行的依據：節點、收邊、材料接合與施工順序在圖上定案，關鍵區域先做實體樣板確認再施作。
qen: Six steps — technical detailing, construction documentation, material coordination, mock-up verification, site quality control and handover documentation — each with a deliverable you receive.
how_h2: 施工深化六步，各步你會拿到什麼？
how: 節點、收邊、材料接合與施工順序圖說；平面、立面、剖面、大樣與工序文件——現場執行的依據。
公司簡介施工深化六步之 01 Technical Detailing、02 Construction Documentation。
材料選樣、供應商確認與交期管控；關鍵區域製作實體樣板，由你在現場確認後才施作。
六步之 03 Material Coordination、04 Mock-up Verification：「關鍵區域實體樣板製作與確認」。
品質查核、進度追蹤與安全管理紀錄；完工時交付竣工圖、操作手冊、保固書與驗收文件。
六步之 05 Site Quality Control、06 Handover Documentation；最終文件 4 類。
cap: 六步時間軸，每步下方為業主實際拿到的文件；末端竣工交付以品牌色與 60° 網線標示四類文件。
why_h2: 施工圖說對業主的意義是什麼？
why: 竣工圖、操作手冊、保固書與驗收文件，營運與後續維護有據可查。
關鍵區域以實體樣板確認，減少完工後的認知落差。
節點、收邊與工序在圖上定案，現場不憑口頭。

ev.t: 中興保全 SECOM 南港總部
ev.claim: 如期完成交付，並達成零重大缺失驗收；竣工圖、操作手冊、保固書與驗收文件隨移交提供。

ev_foot: 2024 年前完成之案件不列為本階段證據。
titleEn: Construction Documentation — the full set you receive
descEn: What will be in your hands at completion? Six steps from technical detailing to handover; you end with as-built drawings, operating manuals, warranties and acceptance records.
h1En: What will you be holding at completion?
ledeEn: What you receive is not only a finished space but an auditable set of documents: as-built drawings, operating manuals, warranties and acceptance records.
inpEn: The integrated BIM model and clash resolutions, final material selections, and mock-up confirmations for key areas.
outEn: A complete set of construction documents — plans, elevations, sections, details and sequencing — plus mock-up records; at completion, as-built drawings, operating manuals, warranties and acceptance records.
howH2En: Six steps of detailing — what you receive at each
whyH2En: What does construction documentation mean for the owner?
howEn: Drawings for junctions, edges, material connections and construction sequence; plans, elevations, sections, details and sequencing documents — the basis for work on site.
Material selection, supplier confirmation and lead-time control; physical mock-ups are made for key areas and built only after you confirm them on site.
Quality checks, progress tracking and safety records; at completion, as-built drawings, operating manuals, warranties and acceptance records are handed over.
whyEn: As-built drawings, operating manuals, warranties and acceptance records give operations and later maintenance something to work from.
Key areas are confirmed with physical mock-ups, reducing the gap between expectation and result at completion.
Junctions, edges and sequence are settled on the drawings; nothing on site runs on verbal instruction.
evFootEn: Projects completed before 2024 are not listed as evidence for this stage.
figAltEn: Construction documentation diagram: six steps from technical detailing, construction documents, material coordination, mock-up sign-off and site quality control to handover, each matched to a document the owner actually receives.
